item.text:
Added view transitions to the product gallery. The selected product image now morphs from its grid thumbnail to the detail hero, product links slide forward and the return link slides back, and Suspense skeletons fade and move into content. A reduced-motion rule disables those animations and the skeleton pulse.

Upgraded React to 19.3 for `ViewTransition` support and pre-rendered the four product routes so the shared images can be paired during navigation. The production build passes, and both the gallery and a product detail route return successfully. I could not visually test the animation because this workspace has no browser installed.
